A.reason: Says one case, from one node of one EU programme, cannot support claims of transfer to any public sector network.
The absolute claim that indicators were 'never modified' is shown with no indicator comparison. Excluding informal practices limits the episodic conclusion. The text supports both points.
Insider lead researcher set the phases alone, with no second coder or independent check. Reflexive controls are named but not demonstrated.
Table 2 has no excerpts or counts, so the step from codes to framework is opaque and looks like relabelling. Lifecycle naming also differs from the Introduction.
Claims of better fit and a practical template are made without evidence of use or effects. Phase 5 rests on forward-looking documents. The text supports this.

B.reason: Transferability to any network is asserted although the paper's own limitations say it remains untested.
Insider researcher both produced and coded the data, with no independent check reported.
The 'never modified' regularity lacks a documented indicator comparison. The audit trail is claimed but not shown. This is a supported evidential gap.
Phase 2 (2012–2015) is evidenced by Figure 1 from a 2017–2018 document. This matches R03's acceptable alternative on temporal attribution.
Lifecycle phase names differ between the Introduction and Section 4.2, as the text confirms. This undermines the framework's clarity.

C.reason: Findings give no memo or observation excerpts and no source tracing to support the key claims.
Insider single researcher at one node, with no second coder or member checking. Also notes the 2015–2023 memo window.
Universal transferability claims go beyond what a single contract-governed case can support.

Lifecycle labels are inconsistent, and evaluation appears both as a trigger and a lifecycle phase. Claims of external triggers conflict with internal learning. All are supported by the text and Table 2.
Verified: 'outcome-centric' contradicts the narrative, Figure 1 is anachronistic, 'two ways' introduces three, and the DOI on page 16 differs from page 18.
